The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] nicknamed "'''Yellow'''" was a member of the [[Gungan Sling Brigade]]. He owed his moniker to his [[Color/Legends|yellow]] uniform and the red paint balls he would throw with his [[Sling/Legends|sling]].

"Yellow" belonged to the [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]] Gungan race, which was characterized by a tall and lanky build, long [[Haillu/Legends|haillu]], a pronounced bill and retractable [[Ommatophora|eyestalks]].
